topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I can't believe I'm hearing this right now. You want to use my yard for your little garden project? The same yard I've been tending to, day in and day out, sun or rain? I mean, we're neighbors and all, but this is a bit much, don't you think? I'm sure you have your reasons, and maybe if you'd talked to me about it before, I might have felt differently. But just showing up and laying claim to part of my space? That's stepping over a line. I appreciate the thought, but this is one hard pass, friend.
